goals.goal: A personal data breach affecting customer account data or task data is notified to the competent supervisory authority without undue delay and, where feasible, no later than 72 hours after TinyTask becomes aware of the breach, unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to data subjects' rights and freedoms, with the Art. 33(3) content template (nature, categories, approximate numbers, consequences, measures, DPO contact) filed.
goals.adjustment: Restated for an 8-person B2B SaaS controller/processor; the `where feasible` softening and `unlikely risk` carve-out are preserved as GDPR-unique conditions per the corpus; the Art. 33(3) content template is the operative filing requirement; no mechanism or tool prescribed.

goals.goal: An actively-exploited vulnerability or severe incident in TinyTask's SaaS product with digital elements is notified to the designated CSIRT and ENISA on the three-tier temporal pattern — early warning within 24 hours, vulnerability or incident notification within 72 hours with progressive disclosure content, and final report within 14 days (AEV) or 1 month (SI) — with the Art. 15 coordinated vulnerability disclosure process operating in parallel without replacing the Art. 14 tiers.
goals.adjustment: Restated for an 8-person manufacturer of default-class SaaS products; the three-tier AEV pathway (24h/72h/14d) and parallel SI pathway (24h/72h/1m) are preserved verbatim from the corpus; the Art. 15 CVD process coordinates but does not replace the Art. 14 notification tiers; no mechanism or tool prescribed.
